newsitem.title: ISRAEL: No Arafat-Netanyahu meeting today - PLO.
newsitem.headline: No Arafat-Netanyahu meeting today - PLO.

text.p: Israel and the Palestinians put off a summit on Tuesday to sew up a Hebron deal because Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is busy with a parliamentary budget debate, a PLO official said.
Palestinian officials had said they expected a meeting between Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat late on Tuesday when negotiators could initial the deal.

"We were informed that the meeting between Netanyahu and Arafat will be delayed until tomorrow because Netanyahu is preoccupied with the budget discussions in the Knesset," said the official, involved in negotiations.
"We have finalised all the issues except for those that will be tackled by the two leaders and we are now trying to conclude the drafting," he said.
